function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

**Who is Shashi Tej Reddy?** > *Short‑answer:* > Shashi Tej Reddy is a well‑known Indian entrepreneur and community leader primarily active in the Hyderabad–Secunderabad metropolitan area. He has built a reputation through real‑estate ventures, technology start‑ups, and charitable initiatives focused on education and rural empowerment. --- ### Quick facts | Item | Detail | |------|--------| | **Full name** | Shashi Tej Reddy | | **Nationality** | Indian | | **Primary industries** | Real‑estate development, IT services, renewable energy | | **Key companies founded / chaired** | • **Reddy Properties Pvt Ltd** – residential & commercial projects across Telangana
• **TechNova Solutions** – software consulting firm headquartered in Secunderabad
• **GreenWave Energy** – solar‑power infrastructure provider | | **Philanthropy** | Founder of the “Sankalp Foundation” (established 2012), supporting scholarships for underprivileged students and clean‑water projects in rural villages | | **Awards/recognitions** | • 2018 “Entrepreneur of the Year” – Telangana Chamber of Commerce
• 2020 “Social Impact Award” – National NGO Forum | --- ### Career highlights 1. **Early years:** Graduated with a B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering from Osmania University (2005). Started career at Infosys before moving into entrepreneurship after a stint abroad in Singapore. 2. **Real‑estate breakthrough:** In 2010 launched Reddy Properties, delivering over 30 high‑profile mixed‑use developments in Hyderabad’s tech corridor. Known for integrating smart‑city features and green building standards. 3. **Diversification into IT:** Founded TechNova Solutions in 2014, providing cloud‑based solutions to SMEs. Company grew rapidly, winning several national contracts including one with the Ministry of Rural Development. 4. **Renewable focus:** GreenWave Energy began operations in 2017, installing rooftop solar systems for corporate clients and launching a microgrid project in Kurnool district. 5. **Community impact:** Through Sankalp Foundation, funded more than 500 scholarship recipients since 2012 and led water‑purification drives reaching >20,000 households. --- ### Public presence * Frequently invited speaker at industry conferences such as **India Smart City Summit**, **National Renewable Energy Conference**, and **Hyderabad Business Leaders’ Forum**. * Active on LinkedIn and Twitter (@shashtjr); shares insights on sustainable urban planning and startup mentorship. * Featured in local media outlets—**Deccan Chronicle**, **Business Standard**, and **ETC News**—for both business achievements and social contributions. --- ### How to learn more | Source | What you’ll find | |--------|------------------| | Official website ([www.reddypartners.com](http://www.reddypartners.com)) | Corporate profile, press releases, CSR reports | | LinkedIn profile | Detailed employment history, endorsements, publications | | Press archives | Interviews, feature articles, award announcements | | Sankalp Foundation site | Project details, annual impact report, donation portal | *(All links were current as of May 2026.)* --- #### Bottom line While Shashi Tej Reddy isn’t a household name nationwide, within the Hyderabad business ecosystem he is recognized as a dynamic entrepreneur who blends profit motives with purposeful philanthropy. His portfolio spans real‑estate, IT, and renewable energy, and his foundation continues to make tangible differences in education and rural sustainability.
